description: This file defines the StartsWithBinary class, which extends AbstractBinary, and provides code to compile a 'starts with' binary expression in Twig templates. It includes methods to generate PHP code for checking if one string starts with another.

classes.name: StartsWithBinary

methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code that checks if the left string starts with the right string, using PHP's str_starts_with function.
